name: EM FX Performance: Fed Hiking vs Cutting Cycles (Per-Cycle Breakdown)
description: Research study analyzing BRL, MXN, and ZAR performance during each individual Fed hiking and cutting cycle since 2000. Uses the Fed Funds Rate to identify regime changes (rate increase = hiking, rate decrease = cutting). FX pairs are inverted (1/USDXXX) so local currency appreciation = positive return. Includes: (1) Per-asset cumulative return line chart with regime shading (original), (2) Cross-sectional summary table with per-cycle return columns so each currency's performance can be compared cycle by cycle, (3) Per-asset bar chart showing return per individual cycle, colored by cycle type (orange for hiking, teal for cutting).
source:
# =============================================================================
# EM FX PERFORMANCE: FED HIKING VS CUTTING CYCLES (PER-CYCLE BREAKDOWN)
# =============================================================================
# Currencies: BRL, MXN, ZAR (inverted from USD/XXX so appreciation = positive)
# Regimes: Fed hiking cycle (rate rising) vs cutting cycle (rate falling)
# Chart 1: Cumulative return per currency with shaded regime bands (original)
# Chart 2: Per-asset bar chart - return per individual cycle (orange=hike, teal=cut)
# Table: Per-cycle return for each currency side-by-side
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c
bar_idx = index()

# =============================================================================
# FED FUNDS DATA & REGIME CLASSIFICATION
# =============================================================================

fed_data = common_economic_indicators(category=MacroEconomicsIndicator.FedFunds)()
fed_value = fed_data.result
had_fed = is_valid(fed_value)

# Prior Fed Funds reading (the one before current)
prior_fed = valuewhen(occurrence=1)(had_fed, fed_value)
fed_change = fed_value - prior_fed

# Regime events: any rate increase starts hiking, any decrease starts cutting
is_hike_event = had_fed and is_valid(fed_change) and (fed_change > 0.0)
is_cut_event = had_fed and is_valid(fed_change) and (fed_change < 0.0)

# Persistent regimes via hold_until
is_hiking = hold_until()(enter=is_hike_event, exit=is_cut_event)
is_cutting = hold_until()(enter=is_cut_event, exit=is_hike_event)

# Regime band signals (1 = active, 0 = inactive) for shaded backgrounds
hiking_band = 1.0 if is_hiking else 0.0
cutting_band = 1.0 if is_cutting else 0.0

# =============================================================================
# INVERTED FX RETURNS (local currency appreciation = positive)
# =============================================================================
inv_close = 1.0 / close
daily_ret = (inv_close - (inv_close >> 1)) / (inv_close >> 1)
daily_ret_clean = daily_ret if is_valid(daily_ret) else 0.0

# =============================================================================
# CUMULATIVE RETURNS (total, hiking-only, cutting-only)
# =============================================================================

cum_total = cumulative()(daily_ret_clean)

# Regime-filtered returns
hiking_ret = daily_ret_clean if is_hiking else 0.0
cutting_ret = daily_ret_clean if is_cutting else 0.0

cum_hiking = cumulative()(hiking_ret)
cum_cutting = cumulative()(cutting_ret)

# =============================================================================
# PER-CYCLE RETURN CALCULATION
# =============================================================================
# A hiking cycle ENDS when a cut_event fires. So cum_hiking at each cut_event
# marks the accumulated hiking return through that point. The difference between
# consecutive cut_event snapshots = the return of one hiking cycle.
# Similarly, a cutting cycle ENDS when a hike_event fires.
#
# valuewhen(occurrence=0) = most recent event, occurrence=1 = second most recent, etc.
# Expected cycles since ~2000: ~3 hikes (2004-06, 2015-18, 2022-23)
#                               ~4 cuts (2001-03, 2007-08, 2019-20, 2024-present)
# =============================================================================

# --- Hiking cycle endpoints (cum_hiking captured at each cut_event) ---
hike_end_0 = valuewhen(occurrence=0)(is_cut_event, cum_hiking)
hike_end_1 = valuewhen(occurrence=1)(is_cut_event, cum_hiking)
hike_end_2 = valuewhen(occurrence=2)(is_cut_event, cum_hiking)
hike_end_3 = valuewhen(occurrence=3)(is_cut_event, cum_hiking)

# Per-cycle hiking returns (reverse chronological: 0 = most recent completed)
hike_ret_0 = hike_end_0 - coalesce(hike_end_1, 0.0)
hike_ret_1 = coalesce(hike_end_1, 0.0) - coalesce(hike_end_2, 0.0)
hike_ret_2 = coalesce(hike_end_2, 0.0) - coalesce(hike_end_3, 0.0)

# Current ongoing hiking cycle (if currently in one)
current_hike_ret = cum_hiking - coalesce(hike_end_0, 0.0)
has_ongoing_hike = is_hiking

# --- Cutting cycle endpoints (cum_cutting captured at each hike_event) ---
cut_end_0 = valuewhen(occurrence=0)(is_hike_event, cum_cutting)
cut_end_1 = valuewhen(occurrence=1)(is_hike_event, cum_cutting)
cut_end_2 = valuewhen(occurrence=2)(is_hike_event, cum_cutting)
cut_end_3 = valuewhen(occurrence=3)(is_hike_event, cum_cutting)

# Per-cycle cutting returns (reverse chronological)
cut_ret_0 = cut_end_0 - coalesce(cut_end_1, 0.0)
cut_ret_1 = coalesce(cut_end_1, 0.0) - coalesce(cut_end_2, 0.0)
cut_ret_2 = coalesce(cut_end_2, 0.0) - coalesce(cut_end_3, 0.0)

# Current ongoing cutting cycle (if currently in one)
current_cut_ret = cum_cutting - coalesce(cut_end_0, 0.0)
has_ongoing_cut = is_cutting

# =============================================================================
# REGIME DAY COUNTS
# =============================================================================

hiking_day = 1.0 if is_hiking else 0.0
cutting_day = 1.0 if is_cutting else 0.0
hiking_day_clean = hiking_day if is_valid(hiking_day) else 0.0
cutting_day_clean = cutting_day if is_valid(cutting_day) else 0.0

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS
# =============================================================================

# --- Chart 1: Cumulative Return with Regime Bands (per asset, original) ---
xy_lines(
    title='EM Currency Cumulative Return with Fed Regime Overlay',
    category='Fed Cycle Impact',
    y_axis_label='Cumulative Return',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Cumulative Return', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Hiking Cum. Return', color=Color.Orange, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Cutting Cum. Return', color=Color.Teal, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Hiking Cycle', color=Color.Orange, is_band=True),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Cutting Cycle', color=Color.Teal, is_band=True)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Breakeven')
    ]),
    order=0
)(x_values=bar_idx, y_values=(cum_total, cum_hiking, cum_cutting, hiking_band, cutting_band))

# --- Chart 2: Per-Cycle Returns Bar Chart (per asset) ---
# Uses grouped mode: stack = cycle label (x-axis), name = cycle type (legend)
# Chronological order: Hike 1 is the earliest completed, Hike 3 is most recent
# Ongoing cycle shown if applicable
xy_bars(
    title='Return per Fed Cycle',
    category='Per-Cycle Breakdown',
    y_axis_label='Cycle Return',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    data_labels=True,
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Hiking', color=Color.Orange, stack='Hike 1 (~2004-06)'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Cutting', color=Color.Teal, stack='Cut 1 (~2001-03)'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Hiking', color=Color.Orange, stack='Hike 2 (~2015-18)'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Cutting', color=Color.Teal, stack='Cut 2 (~2007-08)'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Hiking', color=Color.Orange, stack='Hike 3 (~2022-23)'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Cutting', color=Color.Teal, stack='Cut 3 (~2019-20)'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Cutting', color=Color.Teal, stack='Cut 4 (~2024-)')
    ]),
    order=1
)(values=(hike_ret_2, cut_ret_2, hike_ret_1, cut_ret_1, hike_ret_0, cut_ret_0, current_cut_ret))

# --- Table: Per-Cycle Returns Summary (rows = currencies, columns = cycles) ---
cs_summary_table(
    title='Per-Cycle EM FX Returns (Rows = Currency, Columns = Cycle)',
    category='Per-Cycle Breakdown',
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        title='Per-Cycle EM FX Returns',
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Cut 1 (~01-03)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Hike 1 (~04-06)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Cut 2 (~07-08)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Hike 2 (~15-18)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Cut 3 (~19-20)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Hike 3 (~22-23)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Cut 4 (~24-)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    order=2
)(cut_ret_2, hike_ret_2, cut_ret_1, hike_ret_1, cut_ret_0, hike_ret_0, current_cut_ret)

# --- Table: Aggregate Regime Summary (original) ---
cs_summary_table(
    title='Aggregate Regime Performance Summary',
    category='Fed Cycle Impact',
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        title='Aggregate Regime Performance Summary',
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Hiking Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Cutting Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Hiking Days', type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(title='Cutting Days', type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat)
        ]
    ),
    order=3
)(cum_hiking, cum_cutting, cumulative()(hiking_day_clean), cumulative()(cutting_day_clean))
